notes: Haarlemmerweg 940-1138 (BAG pand 0363100012250972, built 2023, 802 m2 footprint, eaves 46.9 m, 16 storeys at 2.93 m). Photographed after completion: the north (entrance) wall in 2025-07-01 (recording_2025-07-01_09-03-48_00772, 35.9 m camera, 3.2 deg obliquity, 21 % foliage) and the south (canal) wall in 2025-09-26 (2025_09_26_05_36_39_00285, 50.8 m, 0.6 deg, 29 % foliage). The 2019/2022 crops of the same walls show the 1970s-80s concrete block that stood here before, so none of them is evidence for this model; the leaf-off autumn scans (2024-11-21, 2024-11-26) show the tower but are steeply oblique (49-55 deg), 86-88 m off, or blown out (washed-out 0.28-0.88), so they are looked at but not measured.

walls[0] = panel 8 (north, surface 10, 22.6 m, the street front): pale composite panels, 8 pairs of openings on a 2.83 m pair pitch, each pair a wide two-pane window (about 1.2 x 0.9 m) and a narrow slot (about 0.4 x 0.9 m) with a 0.4-0.6 m pier between them; dark frames; a glazed ground floor with the Gymbase Westerpark fascia and entrance. walls[1] = panel 14 (south, surface 17, 21.8 m, the canal front): the same pair rhythm, counted on the 2024-11-21 leaf-off scan (16 openings per floor: 8 wide two-pane, 8 narrow); the 2025-09-26 crop has a plane tree over its left half, so only its right half was counted. walls[2] = panel 17 (east, surface 20, 35.5 m) and walls[3] = panel 2 (west, surfaces 3 and 4, 34 m): no usable photo (the east crop is a 51.6 deg oblique, no panorama reaches the west front over the canal basin) - inferred from the north/south rhythm at the same 2.7-2.8 m pitch, drawn with the wide windows only.

The pair rhythm is the correction this pass made: the draft drew 9 evenly spaced narrow windows on the south front and 8 wide ones on the north, where both photos show the wide-window + narrow-slot pairs. Kit addition needed for it: `windowPattern` (per-bay window widths cycling across the bays, src/canalRecall/blockBuilding/systems.ts, tested in buildingRecipe/largeTier.test.ts), with the bays on the group's own pitch so the piers differ per bay. Triangle budget 22,000 (intent `budgetTriangles`) because 16 storeys x 57 openings cannot be drawn inside the 12,000 default.

Simplified: the white panel skin is exported as render with a measured pale tint (the panel joints are not drawn). Not drawn: the cantilevered white crown that overhangs the south and west corners above a dark recessed gallery (a 3DBAG extrusion cannot overhang, and the kit has no cantilever or recessed-loggia component), the inset upper balconies behind that band, the roof plant enclosure edges and the ground-floor shop glazing subdivisions.

Measured 2026-10-21 (measure.ts, evidence in measured.json): the bay rhythm, front class and the south wall colour come from the crops. Hand-held, with the reason: (a) palette - the north crop is in ambient shade with a blue cast and reads #7ca9bf (chroma 67, so the family classifier says brick) for a pale panel wall, and the south crop's light-trim normalisation is driven by a blown sky highlight that darkens the whole wall to #b7b7b3; palette.brick #d0d0cc sits between that and the south crop's raw panel #d9d9d5. (b) baysPerStorey 16 - the measurement's autocorrelation locks onto the 2.8 m wide-window pair pitch (8 or 9 columns); the photo has 16 openings per floor (8 wide + 8 narrow). (c) windowShape h 0.5, sill 0.25 - counted on the 2024-11-21 leaf-off south scan (wide window 1.33 x 1.5 m, narrow 0.73 x 1.5 m, 3.0 m storeys): the automatic pass reads 0.25 high on the 2025-09-26 crop because the plane tree that fills its left half is classified as glass.
